The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof, as classified
under Section i04 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be
subject to the rates of import duty for the periods in accordance with the schedule
indicated opposite each article.

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles specifically
lis-ted in the aforesaid "Annex" which are entered and withdrawn from warehouses in
the philippines for consumption shall be levied the rates of duty herein prescribed.
